purpose: HMRC Survey of Personal Incomes 2023-24, Table 3.11 (income and tax by sex, region and country): the United Kingdom rows by range of total income, for taxpayers, total income and total tax. The UK row counts the taxpayers HMRC places in no region, so it is larger than the twelve regional areas' sum. Consumed by the national band bridges (uk_runtime.national_reconciliation, microcosm#1123), which check that the factor each bridge applies to the regional cells is the one the UK row over the regional sum explains.
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
